title: Kono Subarashii Sekai ni Shukufuku wo!
englishTitle: KonoSuba: God's Blessing on This Wonderful World!
title_english: KonoSuba: God's Blessing on This Wonderful World!

synonyms: Give Blessings to This Wonderful World!
alternative_titles.en: KonoSuba: God's Blessing on This Wonderful World!
alternative_titles.ja: この素晴らしい世界に祝福を！

synopsis:
After dying a laughable and pathetic death on his way back from buying a game, high school student and recluse Kazuma Satou finds himself sitting before a beautiful but obnoxious goddess named Aqua. She provides the NEET with two options: continue on to heaven or reincarnate in every gamer's dream—a real fantasy world! Choosing to start a new life, Kazuma is quickly tasked with defeating a Demon King who is terrorizing villages. But before he goes, he can choose one item of any kind to aid him in his quest, and the future hero selects Aqua. But Kazuma has made a grave mistake—Aqua is completely useless!

Unfortunately, their troubles don't end here; it turns out that living in such a world is far different from how it plays out in a game. Instead of going on a thrilling adventure, the duo must first work to pay for their living expenses. Indeed, their misfortunes have only just begun!

[Written by MAL Rewrite]
synopsis_es:
Después de sufrir una muerte ridícula y patética al regresar de comprar un juego, el estudiante de secundaria y recluso Kazuma Satou se encuentra sentado ante una hermosa pero desagradable diosa llamada Aqua. Ella le ofrece al NEET dos opciones: continuar hasta el cielo o reencarnar en el sueño de todo jugador: ¡un mundo de fantasía real! Al elegir comenzar una nueva vida, Kazuma rápidamente tiene la tarea de derrotar a un Rey Demonio que está aterrorizando a las aldeas. Pero antes de irse, puede elegir un objeto de cualquier tipo que le ayude en su búsqueda, y el futuro héroe selecciona a Aqua. Pero Kazuma ha cometido un grave error: ¡Aqua es completamente inútil!

Desafortunadamente, sus problemas no terminan aquí; Resulta que vivir en un mundo así es muy diferente a cómo se desarrolla en un juego. En lugar de emprender una aventura emocionante, el dúo primero debe trabajar para pagar sus gastos de manutención. De hecho, ¡sus desgracias apenas han comenzado!

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]

episodes_data.title: This Self-Proclaimed Goddess and Reincarnation in Another World!
episodes_data.title_es: ¡Esta autoproclamada diosa y reencarnación en otro mundo!
episodes_data.description: Gamer Kazuma dies in a freak accident, and is met in the afterlife by a crass goddess, Aqua.

episodes_data.title: An Explosion for This Chunibyo!
episodes_data.description: It`s great for Kazuma that he brought Aqua along with him, but unlike in a game world, much is missing from his adventurer`s lifestyle. No money, no equipment, and even fighting the lowest ranking monsters is a hard-fought battle. That`s when they decide to recruit new party members.

episodes_data.title: A Panty Treasure in This Right Hand!
episodes_data.title_es: ¡Un tesoro de bragas en esta mano derecha!
episodes_data.description: A low-grade goddess turned arch priest who works hard to acquire party trick skills, a dissapointing arch wizard who can only unleash explosion magic once per day, and Kazuma himself, whose only redeeming quality is his good luck. Kazuma despairs over the completely useless party that`s been formed.

episodes_data.title: Explosion Magic for This Formidable Enemy!
episodes_data.title_es: ¡Magia de explosión para este formidable enemigo!
episodes_data.description: All of the weak monsters have gone into hiding since a leader of the devil king`s army has settled in near town. Kazuma, who had been focusing on improving his skills, is stuck at a standstill. With nothing else to do, Kazuma tags along with Megumin`s training, which consists of unleashing explosion magic into an abandoned castle.

episodes_data.title: A Price for This Cursed Sword!
episodes_data.description: With debt looming over her, Aqua convinces Kazuma to accept a high difficulty quest to purify a lake, which doesn`t require killing any monsters.

episodes_data.title: A Conclusion to This Worthless Fight!
episodes_data.description: Dullahan, a top leader in the Devil King`s army, yet again appears at the city in a frenzied rage.

episodes_data.title: A Second Death in This Freezing Season!
episodes_data.title_es: ¡Una segunda muerte en esta temporada de heladas!
episodes_data.description: "I want money." After paying back the debt Aqua has racked up, Kazuma and Aqua`s monetary situation grows even more dire. The party accepts a quest to kill helpless Snow Sprites and heads for the snowy mountains in order to escape from the stables during this winter so cold it freezes Kazuma`s eyelashes solid.

episodes_data.title: A Loving Hand for Our Party When We Can't Make It Through Winter!
episodes_data.title_es: ¡Una mano amorosa para nuestra fiesta cuando no podemos pasar el invierno!
episodes_data.description: Kazuma and Aqua can`t properly accept rewards from quests due to their mediocre party lineup, and are so destitute that even keeping wood on the fire is difficult. Kazuma comes up with a plan and visits a magical accessories shop run by a woman called Wiz.

episodes_data.title: God's Blessing on This Wonderful Shop!
episodes_data.title_es: ¡La bendición de Dios en esta maravillosa tienda!
episodes_data.description: Kazuma runs into some adventurers he knows while out for a walk and decides to go with them to a shop run by succubi said to show its customers enticing dreams.

episodes_data.title: Final Flame for This Over-the-Top Fortress!
episodes_data.description: The rampaging ancient weapon: the mobile fortress, Destroyer, is headed straight for Kazuma and party`s city!
